response.overview: A fast-paced, allegorical satirical comedy tackling the heavy reality of global warming. The story follows humanity's obsession with unchecked urban expansion and destructive construction across famous global landmarks. As nature's ecosystem reaches its breaking point, melting polar ice caps trigger a sudden, global environmental backlash—ultimately delivering a harsh, swift "checkmate" to the hubris of the human race.
